MehrgarhCivilization
Pakistan's history reveals that it has been home to some of the world's earliest
civilizations. Mehrgarh, Mohenjo-Daro, Harappa, Taxila have all been recognized as
important archaeological sites around the world. Mehrgarh is thought to be the
forerunner of the Indus Valley Civilization. Between 7000 and 5500 BC, Mehrgarh
was a small pre-lndus farming and pastoral settlement located at the foot of the
BolanPassinBalochistan,Pakistan.
